versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Medical Genetics 8th Edition skill set:

- Covers 131 core genetics skills based on the 8th edition of Medical Genetics.
- Encompasses chromosome analysis, Mendelian inheritance, mitochondrial disease, prenatal diagnosis, gene therapy, and epigenetic regulation.
- Structured categorization with detailed skill counts and descriptions for each field.
- Designed for clinical Q&A, decision support, and educational case design.
- Includes example prompts for practical usage.
- MIT-0 licensed; see [index.md](index.md) for full skill list.
